randomization.verdict: Pass. With randomised weights the heatmaps change almost completely (mean correlation 0.00), so Grad-CAM reflects what the model learned, not just image edges.

border.verdict: Mostly reassuring. The median border share (28%) is below the 36% expected from evenly spread attention, so most heatmaps concentrate inside the image. 30 test X-rays (4.8%) still put more than 50% of their attention on the edges, and the app adds a caution message for results like those.
